avg_retail_price_by_category.description: Computes the average retail price of catalog products grouped by category.
avg_retail_price_by_category.returns: One row per category with average retail price
avg_retail_price_by_category.sql_template: SELECT category, AVG(retail_price) AS avg_retail_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_retail_price DESC

SELECT * FROM order_items

get_active_orders.description: Returns all non-terminal Order rows. Applies: status NOT IN ('Complete', 'Cancelled', 'Returned')

orderitem_sale_price.description: Order Line-grain revenue: SUM(sale_price). Use for revenue sliced by a product/line dimension where order-level totals cannot be apportioned. Do not re-derive from unit price × quantity.

return_rate.description: The share of sold lines that the customer sent back.
return_rate.formula_sql: SUM(CASE WHEN returned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)

revenue.description: Item-grain gross booked revenue: SUM(order_items.sale_price) over items not Cancelled. Cancelled items never shipped, so they are excluded by default. Returned items WERE fulfilled then reversed — they are INCLUDED in gross booked revenue; exclude them (status NOT IN (Cancelled, Returned)) only when net-of-returns is explicitly asked for. Gross booked = 9,152,264.79; net of returns = 8,097,573.12.

units_sold.description: Item-grain count of inventory units that have sold. Replaces the explorer's "Sales Volume by Category", whose SQL — COUNT(id) over sold inventory_items — carried no category at all: the name promised a breakdown the formula never made. Category is a DIMENSION of this metric (product_category), not part of its identity; slice it to get the breakdown. Total = 180,342.
